INNER HEAD. [3] [Am. c.]
Sense of oppressive fulness, pushing as if forehead would burst.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Am. c.]
Nosebleed : when washing face or hands in morning nose bleeds from left nostril ; from right several days in succession, weakening boy. θ Undeveloped measles.
Stoppage, mostly at night ; must breathe through mouth, with long-lasting coryza. θ Scarlatina.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Am. c.]
Cholera-like symptoms at commencement of catamenia.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Am. c.]
One of the best remedies in emphysema.
   

COUGH. [27] [Am. c.]
Cough at night ; every morning, at 3 o'clock, dry cough from tickling in throat, as of dust.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Am. c.]
Angina pectoris.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Am. c.]
Panaritium ; finger inflamed ; deep-seated periosteal pain.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Am. c.]
Outer pressure : headache > ; constrictive pain in stomach > ; pain in bowels >.
   

SKIN. [46] [Am. c.]
Body red as if covered with scarlatina.
Malignant scarlatina with somnolence, starting from sleep ; dark red or putrid sore throat ; sticky salivation ; parotitis ; external throat swollen ; stertorous breathing ; involuntary stools with excessive vomiting ; body red, with miliary rash, or faintly developed eruption ; threatened paralysis of brain.
